# vendor

Copies of other projects' files, at one named version each and left as their authors wrote them,
by the workspace's `docs/vendor.md`.

| Entry                 | What it is                                                                   |
| --------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `reserved-usernames/` | names a site keeps from its users, a source of the names no account or organization is given, RFC v7v3w |
| `cose-examples/`      | COSE's Sign1, EdDSA and CWT cases, the samples `codec*` is held to, RFC fhg6w |
